svg.text: Effective-cavity LA PV is a shadow diagnostic axis, not acceptance; blood-volume PV remains the physiology-facing mass-ledger audit. This SVG hides rows unless blood v-loop area/separation, immediate post-MV-opening conduit/downstroke, source/MVF cleanliness, capacity/effective PV phase, and hidden-volume hygiene pass; x-descent depth, broad chord-below, and global kink markers are warnings.
